title: Nutty Venezuelan Dates Empanadas
description: A savory hangover cure empanada filled with medjool dates, cure in shio-koji for a unique twist. Perfect as a breakfast, brunch, or snack option.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine shio-koji and warm water, stirring until dissolved.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, cold butter, and salt.
Use a pastry blender or your fingertips to work butter into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add egg and mix until dough comes together in a ball.
Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of date mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold dough over filling and press edges together to seal.
Brush tops of empanadas with egg wash and sprinkle with chopped pecans.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
